Meera Bhat: hi everyone :wave: i'm Meera — just joined as a PM on Product Infra. based in LON (GMT), pronouns she/her. obsessed with oatmeal, tiny succulents, and bad ukulele covers. i'll be in the SF office next Tue-Wed — desk W3 if you want to drop snacks ;) quick q: who's the best person to talk to about getting an extra monitor & a dock? also — what's the coffee situation like in the office? :coffee:

Alex Chen: welcome Meera!! :tada: alex here. for monitors ping @ops-desks or dm me, i have a spare HDMI dongle you can borrow.

Marta Ruiz: welcome! i'm Marta from People Ops — hi @meera. i've filed a hardware request on your behalf, will follow up with timelines. also if you want a snack preference box added, tell me your must-haves.

Liam O'Neill: if you like succulents, i have a tiny echeveria you can adopt :seedling:

People Ops Bot: Carla set hardware ticket #10234 for Meera — ETA 2 business days.

Devex-Bot: added you to the #ukulele-and-late-night-coding channel :guitar: enjoy the memes.

Priya Shah: london crew here — hi @meera! we usually do drinks on fridays. fancy meeting Fri 6pm at The Anchor?

Meera Bhat: yesss friday sounds perfect! also heads up i'm allergic to cilantro (sadly) so please mark the snack note. thanks everyone!! :heart:

Zoe Martinez: :wave: welcome! quick tip — label your lunch in the fridge, otherwise it tends to disappear mysteriously :eyes:

Alex Chen: we've got a running 'mystery-fridge thief' emoji poll each month. ps saved you a USB-C dock in the storage closet labeled "meera".

Meera Bhat: legend — i'll swing by storage W3 later today. see you all friday :smile:
